name: What maintenance is required for an outdoor fire feature?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for an outdoor fire feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance for an outdoor fire feature typically involves regular cleaning to remove ash, debris, or any buildup from use, especially for wood-burning units. Gas fire features require less internal cleaning but should have their igniters and gas lines inspected periodically to ensure proper function and safety. A good preparation step is to keep a cover on your fire feature when not in use to protect it from weather elements and prolong its lifespan. Our team can offer guidance on specific care for the materials and type of fire feature installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance includes regular cleaning for wood-burning units and periodic inspection for gas features. Covering the unit when not in use helps protect it from elements.
